stem: The price of an item was increased by \(25\%\). The new price was then decreased by \(x\%\), and the resulting price was \(10\%\) greater than the original price. What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Let the original price be \(P\). After the increase: \(1.25P\). After the decrease: \(1.25P\left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right)\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
ans = solve(Eq(Rational(125, 100)*(1 - x/100), Rational(110, 100)), x)[0]
assert ans == 12
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
